risk_if_not_implemented: Without Preventative Access Restriction, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Personnel Sanctions
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to sanction personnel failing to comply with established security policies, standards and procedures.
compensating_control_1.justification: Personnel Sanctions (HRS-10) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Preventative Access Restriction (HRS-10.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Audit Planning Activities
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to thoughtfully plan audits by including input from operational risk and compliance partners to minimize the impact of audit-related activities on business operations.
compensating_control_2.justification: Audit Planning Activities (CPL-07.3) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Preventative Access Restriction (HRS-10.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
